name: GDP
note: current US$; also kept at constant 2015 US$ (NY.GDP.MKTP.KD) and at PPP, current international $ (NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.CD)

name: GDP per person
note: current US$; also at constant 2015 US$ (NY.GDP.PCAP.KD) and at PPP (NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD)

name: real growth
note: GDP at constant prices, the year over the year before

name: 10-year growth
note: GDP at constant 2015 US$, compound yearly growth over the ten years to the figure's year

name: household spending per person
note: households' final consumption, current US$, over the people

name: trade balance
note: exports less imports of goods and services

name: taking part in work
note: labour force participation rate, ILO modelled estimate

name: average wage
note: average annual wage, current prices, at the year's exchange rate

name: minimum wage
note: statutory minimum wage a year, current prices, at the year's exchange rate

name: minimum against average wage
note: the minimum wage over the mean wage of full-time workers

name: inflation
note: consumer prices, the year's average over the year before

name: policy rate
source: bis:WS_CBPOL_csv_col.zip|FREQ=M,nation=REF_AREA(ISO2),time=columns 2025-12 back to 2025-01 (the last one not empty),value=that cell
note: the central bank's policy rate at the year's end

name: 10-year yield
note: long-term government bond yield, the year's average

name: real interest rate
note: lending rate less the GDP deflator's inflation

name: currency against parity
note: the market rate over the PPP rate, both local money a US$: above 1, the money buys more at home than its market rate says

name: price level against the US
note: the PPP conversion factor over the market rate (the US is 1)

name: debt in foreign money
source: none:no open source publishes the currency share of public debt for most nations (the IMF's terms do not allow it)

name: budget balance
note: central government net lending (+) or borrowing (-)

name: interest
note: central government interest payments over revenue

name: city fund
source: none:no source whose terms let a game ship them publishes sovereign funds' assets

name: credit rating
source: none:the rating agencies' terms do not let a game ship their ratings

name: pensions
note: public spending on old-age and survivors' pensions

name: bank capital ratio
note: bank capital and reserves over total assets

name: credit to firms and households
note: domestic credit to the private sector

name: stock market
note: market capitalisation of listed domestic companies

name: household debt
note: households' debt over their net disposable income

name: net migration
note: arrivals less departures in the year

name: people per household
source: none:no source the study names publishes it for most nations

name: rent
source: none:no comparable published figure across nations (D10's rule)

name: homes per 1,000
source: oecd:AHD_HM1-1-Housing-stock-and-construction.xlsx|sheet=HM1.1.A1,nation=col A (the country name),value=col J else col I,time=col M else col L
note: the housing stock (OECD Affordable Housing Database)

name: without a home per 10,000
source: oecd:AHD_HC3-1-Population-experiencing-homelessness.xlsx|sheet=Table_HC3.1.A1,nation=col A (the country name),value=col B (a fraction of the people; a text cell is read as a percent and NA skipped),time=col J (its first four digits),mul=10000
note: the homeless counted (OECD Affordable Housing Database)

name: households sharing
source: none:no comparable published figure across nations

name: home price to income
source: none:the OECD's price-to-income series is an index, not a level that ranks

name: prisoners
source: none:UNODC allows personal non-commercial use only on its current terms page (older dataUNODC terms allowed free reuse if cited); Jerus to decide, see MEASURES-SOURCES.txt

name: police
source: none:UNODC allows personal non-commercial use only on its current terms page (older dataUNODC terms allowed free reuse if cited); Jerus to decide, see MEASURES-SOURCES.txt

name: water per person
note: annual freshwater withdrawals over the people

name: cars per 1,000
source: none:no source the study names publishes it (the WDI's series ended; OICA's terms)

name: commutes by transit
source: none:no comparable published figure across nations or cities

name: oil produced
source: eia:INTL.zip|file=INTL.txt (one JSON series a line),series_id=INTL.57-1-<ISO3>-TBPD.A,time=data[n][0],value=data[n][1] (thousand barrels a day)
